# Caribbean Reserve

Experience a taste of the tropics with The Glenlivet Caribbean Reserve, a single malt whisky selectively\* finished in Caribbean rum casks.

\*a portion of the single malt is finished in Caribbean rum casks.

## CASK

Selectively finished in Caribbean rum barrels.

## NOSE

Sweet notes of pear and apple meet a fabulous tropical twist of ripe banana in syrup.

## PALATE

Rich caramel toffee notes are followed by mandarin orange, vanilla and honeydew melon.

## FINISH

Citrusy and exceptionally smooth.

## Bold & Vibrant

A portion of this single malt has been finished in Caribbean rum casks for a burst of vibrant tropical fruit notes intertwined with a smooth, caramel infused sweetness. An exotic twist on our classic single malt with every sip evoking a new bold new flavour.

Perfect to enjoy with a refreshing mixer or neat, just the way you like it.

## CARRIBEAN RESERVE faqs

### What is The Glenlivet Caribbean Reserve?           The Glenlivet Caribbean Reserve is a tropical-tasting smooth scotch whisky. A portion of the whisky has been selectively finished in oaks barrels that previously held Caribbean rum to give it a flavourful twist.

### What does The Glenlivet Caribbean Reserve taste like?           Imagine a warm evening on a white sand beach as you hear a gentle breeze move through palm leaves and the crystal waters lap at the shore. That’s sort of what The Glenlivet Caribbean Reserve tastes like. It captures the essence of the Caribbean by delivering rich caramel toffee to the palate followed by flavours of tropical fruits. Its aroma is an enticing blend of pear, red apple, and ripe bananas in syrup. Overall, it’s bold yet smooth and perfect for summer serves.

### What can you mix with The Glenlivet Caribbean Reserve?           You can lean into the tropical notes of The Glenlivet Caribbean Reserve by pairing it with other fruity flavours. For example, the [Tartan Tiki](https://www.theglenlivet.com/en/whisky-cocktails/tartan-tiki-drink-recipe/) is our take on the classic Mai Tai and pairs smooth scotch whisky with pineapple juice, Angostura Bitters and peach sparkling water. Or for something a little more indulgent, try a [Coco Noche](https://www.theglenlivet.com/en/?post_type=drink&p=40056) by mixing The Glenlivet Caribbean Reserve with coconut cream, milk, almond extract and ground allspice.

### How long is The Glenlivet Caribbean Reserve aged for?           The Glenlivet Caribbean Reserve has no age statement but like all scotch whiskies, it has been aged for a minimum of three years in oak casks and a portion is finished in ex-Caribbean rum barrels.

### How many calories are in The Glenlivet Caribbean Reserve?           There are 66 calories in 30ml of The Glenlivet Caribbean Reserve and 221 calories in 100ml. Click [here](https://e-label.pernod-ricard.com/L01354) for more product information. The calories in your finished drink may vary depending on the mixers you add. Get more information on the [nutritional content of our whiskies](https://www.theglenlivet.com/en/nutritional-information/).

### How much is The Glenlivet Caribbean Reserve?           We are unable to advise on individual supplier’s pricing for The Glenlivet Caribbean Reserve, but we recommend that you take some time to browse online to find your local The Glenlivet suppliers and compare prices.

### Where can you buy The Glenlivet Caribbean Reserve?           The Glenlivet Caribbean Reserve single malt scotch whisky is available to buy from numerous reputable international suppliers, both in person and online. Use our “Where to buy” tool above to find your nearest supplier.
